title: Repack independent stereo FLAC as mid-side using parity-state residuals

definition.title: Repack independent stereo FLAC as mid-side using parity-state residuals
definition.source_excerpt: Can stereo decorrelation be performed on prediction residuals without reconstructing both full-amplitude channels? FLAC defines independent stereo and reversible mid-side stereo. Its mid channel uses a right-shifted sum, and its side channel needs an additional precision bit. Fixed predictors and residuals provide a precise restricted input profile. [S6] Define e[n] = (L[n] + R[n]) mod 2, with e in {0,1}, including for negative sums. Then: The parity state can be advanced without reconstructing L or R: rM[n] = (rL[n] + rR[n] - e[n] + e[n-1]) / 2 rS[n] = rL[n] - rR[n] The numerator for rM is even. The parity correction preserves the floor behavior that a naive average of residuals would lose. Convert the first warm-up samples into M[0], S[0], and e[0]; then Rice-encode the transformed residuals and construct truthful mid-side framing.
